compilers.hello:
program main
    implicit none
    character(len=256) :: line
    integer :: ios

    read (*, '(a)', iostat=ios) line
    if (ios /= 0) line = ''
    print '(a)', 'Hello from Flux'
    print '(2a)', 'You typed: ', trim(line)
end program main

compilers.label: Pascal
Assembly
compilers.hello:
; x86-64 Linux. A program with main is linked with the C library.
extern fgets, printf, puts, strcspn, stdin

section .data
hello   db "Hello from Flux", 0
fmt     db "You typed: %s", 10, 0
eol     db 13, 10, 0

section .bss
line    resb 256

section .text
global main
main:
    push rbx                    ; aligns the stack for calls
    lea rdi, [rel hello]
    call puts
    lea rdi, [rel line]
    mov esi, 256
    mov rdx, [rel stdin]
    call fgets                  ; at end of input, line stays empty
    lea rdi, [rel line]
    lea rsi, [rel eol]
    call strcspn
    lea rdi, [rel line]
    mov byte [rdi + rax], 0     ; cut the line ending
    lea rdi, [rel fmt]
    lea rsi, [rel line]
    xor eax, eax
    call printf
    pop rbx
    xor eax, eax
    ret
